fields.title: Facebook event record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one event per row. One EVENT row per event, one RUN_SUMMARY per run, ERROR rows when a search or page returns nothing. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search term or page this record came from.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: events_unavailable or unexpected_error.

eventId.title: Event ID
eventId.description: Facebook's numeric id for the event.

eventUrl.title: Event URL
eventUrl.description: Link to the event on Facebook.

dayTimeSentence.title: When (as shown)
dayTimeSentence.description: Facebook's own line, e.g. 'Sun, 20 Sep at 16:00 EDT'. Localised and abbreviated, and the only date a page's events tab publishes.

startTimestamp.title: Start (epoch)
startTimestamp.description: Exact start time in epoch seconds. Present on search results; absent on page-tab events.

startsAtIso.title: Starts at
startsAtIso.description: ISO 8601 UTC start time, converted from startTimestamp. Null when Facebook published only the sentence.

isPast.title: Past
isPast.description: Whether Facebook marks the event as finished.

isCanceled.title: Cancelled
isCanceled.description: Whether the event has been cancelled.

placeName.title: Venue
placeName.description: Venue label. Most Facebook events use a free-text place with no separate name, in which case this is the first segment of the address the organiser typed.

placeAddress.title: Address
placeAddress.description: The full address line, e.g. '149 Irving Ave, Brooklyn, NY, United States, New York 11237'.

city.title: City
city.description: City, where Facebook attaches a structured place.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Only on events attached to a structured place.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Only on events attached to a structured place.

priceRangeText.title: Ticket price
priceRangeText.description: Facebook's ticketing line, where the event sells tickets.

hostName.title: Host
hostName.description: The page or person hosting. Populated on page-tab events; search results often omit it.

goingCount.title: Going
goingCount.description: Parsed from Facebook's attendance line ('1 going'). Facebook abbreviates large counts, so this is approximate; attendanceText keeps the original.

interestedCount.title: Interested
interestedCount.description: Parsed from the attendance line the same way.

coverPhotoUrl.title: Cover photo
coverPhotoUrl.description: Cover image. A signed CDN link that expires.

coverPhotoCaption.title: Cover photo text
coverPhotoCaption.description: Facebook's machine-generated alt text for the cover image. It often contains the poster's headline, which is the closest thing to a description the public payload carries - the event's own description page is not readable logged out.

query.title: Query
query.description: The search term or page slug behind this row.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: The Facebook URL this row came from.

overview.title: Events
overview.description: One row per event: what, when, where.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Sort by exact start time to build a schedule.
